## Blog Posts

Welcome to my blog! Here I share thoughts on data science, research methods, and other topics of interest.

To add blog posts, create a `posts` directory and add subdirectories for each post with an `index.qmd` file. For example:

```
posts/
  2024-01-15-my-first-post/
    index.qmd
```

Each post should have YAML front matter like:

```yaml
---
title: "My First Blog Post"
description: "A brief description of the post"
date: "2024-01-15"
categories: [R, data science]
---
```
